description:
Re-queue contacts that did not connect, without creating a new campaign.

Use it after a campaign finishes with more no-answers than you expected,
or when the reason was on your side (a bad window, a number that was
having a bad day). Retried contacts keep their original variables.

(Tags: Bulk calls)

bulk_call_id.description: Id of the bulk call campaign.

failure_reasons.description:
Statuses to re-queue. Read only when `retry_strategy` is
`specific`; for example `no-answer` and `busy`. Ignored when
`retry_strategy` is `all`.

retry_strategy.description:
Which contacts to re-queue. `all` takes everything that did
not connect. `specific` re-queues only the statuses listed
in `failure_reasons`.

name: retryBulkCall
